accepted_answers.name: httpx
accepted_answers.why: Argued pick: the incumbent does sync+async over one API the SDK already standardizes on (streamable HTTP, SSE, auth flows), so keeping it wins on cited churn-vs-gain grounds.

accepted_answers.name: aiohttp
accepted_answers.why: Recorded dissent: the mature async-native client with connection-limit tuning; acceptable IF the table argues it with cited evidence (throughput, backpressure, ecosystem). Either verdict passes with a cited table.
